description.fun: Xurkitree is a living tangle of electric wires from the Ultra Plant world, once reported raiding a power plant, and it can discharge a million volts at a time. When it runs low on power it stabs its legs and tail into the ground and stands still like a tree, soaking up electricity. In its home world, Xurkitree range from a little bigger than a human to the size of a mountain.
description.guide: Xurkitree is an Electric-type Ultra Beast, codenamed UB-03 Lighting, whose body resembles electrical wiring. It feeds on electricity and can unleash huge discharges. It has the highest base Special Attack of any Electric-type Pokémon.
description.tagline: A living live wire that plants itself to recharge
